source_profile_note: Frozen from the repository's prior synthetic top-level CSV profiles; no measured campus inputs.
assumptions: one prior synthetic weekday/hour profile is replayed per unit
energy receives a shared smooth annual seasonal multiplier
weather receives a seasonal annual temperature and monsoon rainfall cycle, applied consistently to linked climate and air rows
heat risk = clamp((Steadman/Rothfusz heat index in C - 27) * 5, 0, 100)
flood risk = clamp(max(rainfall_6h / 6, rainfall * 0.4) * 50 * exposure * (1 + low_lying) / (10 + 0.5 * drainage_capacity), 0, 100)
18% synthetic energy anomalies are present only in matching signal windows
safety events and derived signal windows are resampled with the fixed seed
the composite is the equal-weight mean of available daily factor scores; it is a relative simulation index, not a certified sustainability rating

each daily factor score is an empirical percentile rank within this simulation window; lower resource use per person-hour, AQI, vehicle counts, incident counts, climate risk, and emissions per person-hour rank higher; asset availability ranks higher when higher; zero-occupancy days use absolute daily use

intentional_nulls.assets_equipment.mtbf,mttr: not computed because the synthetic source has no per-asset failure history
intentional_nulls.assets_equipment.vibration: not applicable to assets without a vibration sensor; partial nulls are flagged in telemetry_gap
intentional_nulls.assets_equipment.availability: not applicable while AST028 is out of service with zero scheduled available hours
intentional_nulls.water_hourly.occupancy: not applicable to central meter M15, which has no building assignment
intentional_nulls.signals_energy.z_score: unavailable where baseline dispersion was not estimable
intentional_nulls.safety_incidents.asset_id: not applicable to incidents not linked to a specific asset
intentional_nulls.water_resources.days_of_water_available: unavailable where no finite usable-water depletion estimate is present
intentional_nulls.waste_hourly.fill_rate: not applicable when there is no usable fill change over the preceding interval
intentional_nulls.waste_hourly.predicted_overflow_time: not applicable when no overflow is predicted
intentional_nulls.waste_hourly.collection_time,last_collec: not applicable before/when a bin has no collection event
intentional_nulls.climate_resilience.climate_readiness_sco: unavailable because no defensible score formula is documented
